I is staggered with the CH3 groups 180° apart (anti): lowest energy. II is staggered with the CH3 groups 60° apart (gauche): about 3.8 kJ/mol higher, from steric strain. III is eclipsed (one CH3/H and two H/H eclipsing interactions): about 16 kJ/mol above anti, because eclipsing adds torsional strain that any staggered form avoids.
Answer: I < II < III.
